metric_definitions.readmissions_reached: True held-out readmissions among patients the policy would call (true labels only).
metric_definitions.expected_avoided_readmissions: True label x mid effect of the assigned action. DEPENDS ON ASSUMED EFFECT SIZES - assumption, not a prediction.
metric_definitions.expected: Raw risk may tie or win on readmissions reached; that is expected. Metrics are mean with 10th-90th percentile over the simulated days.
metric_definitions.eligibility: All four policies draw from the same pool: patients with at least one eligible action, using the same eligibility rules.
